note: Fail-closed: a malformed file, an unknown status, or any BLOCKED gate means production ingestion is blocked. Only explicit owner/reviewer evidence flips a gate. Importers enforce this file at startup (scripts/ingestion-gates.mjs).

gates.title: Production-data stage explicitly approved (lock lifted in writing)
gates.evidenceRequired: Written stage approval naming stage, source(s), maintainer, and license basis per source
gates.passCriteria: Approval exists, names this stage, and is recorded with date + decider

gates.title: License decision recorded (LICENSE_DECISION_RECORD.md section 4 complete)
gates.evidenceRequired: Grant file(s) + completed decision record + matrix licenseStatus flips with evidence
gates.passCriteria: LICENSE grant exists; matrix + corpus tripwires updated consistently; suite green
gates.statusEvidence: No LICENSE file; OWNER_DECISIONS.json is 5/5 OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED.

gates.title: Advisory-record review capacity confirmed (a human opens every source URL)
gates.evidenceRequired: Named reviewer(s) + capacity statement covering the batch size; no bulk unreviewed ingest ever
gates.passCriteria: Reviewer named, capacity covers the batch, HONESTY.md checklist acknowledged

gates.title: App-side provider design accepted (ingested data has a verified consumer contract)
gates.evidenceRequired: App-repo provider design (range policy, zero-match semantics, config-lock amendment) accepted by app maintainers
gates.passCriteria: Design accepted in the app repo; consumer contract pinned
gates.statusEvidence: No provider design exists; Null provider still locked.
